author: hoodintheearl
quote: The game is an absolute insult to the intelligence and integrity of the person who is playing the game. It's uncreative, unintelligent and has a forced agenda - evident by the poor performances of the characters in the game. The characters are flat, bland and not memorable at all. The mechanics of the game are unfinished, unpolished and filled to the brim with buggy animations. By the time you finish the game, you'll be too empty to even feel the ending. This is by far the worst game ever made by Rockstar. It doesn't have a "soul" to bind all the other elements of the game. The game is an absolute **** in writing and creativity. A 15 year old could have written a better game than this in my opinion, with a definite beginning, middle and an end. THE STORY IS EVERYTHING, not anything else. Not the shiny graphics or the overhyped marketing or the nudity. This is after 13 YEARS in development. What a joke. Missed Dan Houser profoundly throughout the unfolding of this stupid game. Absolute worst. This game is a zero for me, since it is nothing but a waste of time, energy and money. RIP Rockstar.
